# AnimalPose

Kind: component · Defined in [`src/logic/animals/animal.h`](../../../src/logic/animals/animal.h) · Described in `data/animals.json`

The joints of an animal now: local poses, model space matrices and skinning matrices.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `local` | `std::vector<JointPose>` | Each joint relative to its parent (translation, rotation, scale), the clip's. |
| `world` | `std::vector<glm::mat4>` | Model space matrices of the joints (bent and planted by AnimalGait). |
| `skin` | `std::vector<glm::mat4>` | world times inverse bind: what AnimalPass uploads. |

## Notes

Emplaced by AnimalAnimation on every Animal whose species loads; AnimalGait rewrites world and skin; AnimalBotSteer writes world only on its proxies. Read by AnimalPass, riders (saddle), AnimalAgentView.

## Systems that touch it

Read only by: AnimalLineup, AnimalWalkers, MountSpawn, Mountables, Mounting, RiderSeat, animals. Written by: AnimalAgentView, AnimalAnimation, AnimalBotSteer, AnimalGait. Created by: AnimalAgentView, AnimalAnimation, AnimalBotSteer. Destroyed by: AnimalBotSteer, Herds.

| [AnimalAgentView](../systems/AnimalAgentView.md) | system | Host | **write+create** | tick | world joints from skeletonFromSegments and skin matrices, every tick |
| [AnimalAnimation](../systems/AnimalAnimation.md) | system | Host | **write+create** | tick | Emplaced when missing; local, world and skin overwritten by evaluate(). |
| [AnimalBotSteer](../systems/AnimalBotSteer.md) | system | Host | **write+create** | tick | Emplaced when the species is in the library; world overwritten. |

| [AnimalLineup](../systems/AnimalLineup.md) | system | Host | **read** | preinit | storage only: the pool is made before the first view; AnimalAnimation writes the poses |
| [AnimalWalkers](../systems/AnimalWalkers.md) | system | Host | **read** | preinit | storage only: the pool is made before the first view; AnimalAnimation writes the poses |
| [Herds](../systems/Herds.md) | system | Host | **destroy** | despawn | Destroyed with the member. |
| [MountSpawn](../systems/MountSpawn.md) | system | Host | **read** | preinit (storage only) | its pool is made so that later views over it exist; not otherwise touched |

| [RiderSeat](../systems/RiderSeat.md) | system | Host | **read** | tick (helper saddleOf) | world matrix of the joint that carries the saddle |
| [animals](../systems/pass-animals.md) | pass | Host | **read** | update | skin matrices copied into the frame's joint buffer. |

## Side effects of those systems

- **[AnimalAgentView](../systems/AnimalAgentView.md)**
  - Loads the animal library index (preinit) and the viewed species (first tick) from disk on the main thread; logs which.
  - With "log", opens the file once (truncated) and appends a CSV line every frame, flushed.
  - ImGui window "Animal".
  - Creates host entities (one skin per world with a built bot, 800 tiles with marks) that are never destroyed (no finish).
- **[AnimalAnimation](../systems/AnimalAnimation.md)**
  - Reads resources/animals/library.json and each species' .json, .bin and .anim on first use.
  - Logs the library's size or absence, and each species that fails to load.
  - Runs taskflow tasks (batches of 16 animals when there are more than 32) and waits for them.
- **[AnimalBotSteer](../systems/AnimalBotSteer.md)**
  - Creates one proxy entity per world with a built animal, destroys them in finish.
  - Writes into other registries: the AnimalBot command of each world, read at the next world step.
- **[AnimalGait](../systems/AnimalGait.md)**
  - Logs one line per species and gait clip analysed.
  - Queries the ground field several times per foot per frame.
- **[AnimalLineup](../systems/AnimalLineup.md)**
  - Creates one entity per animal in init.
  - Logs missing species, the origin, and each animal's place, height and clip count.
- **[AnimalWalkers](../systems/AnimalWalkers.md)**
  - Creates one entity per animal in init.
  - Logs missing species or walks and each animal's clip, speed, radius and place.
  - Queries the ground field per animal per tick.
- **[Herds](../systems/Herds.md)**
  - Reads the herd definition JSON under ./resources/ in init.
  - Creates and destroys member entities as the viewer moves (destroying every component on them).
  - Logs warnings for missing members, an error for a bad definition, an info line at init, a debug line per herd spawned.
  - Queries the ground field per member per tick and the generator's heightfield for slopes.
- **[MountSpawn](../systems/MountSpawn.md)**
  - Creates `count` animal entities in init.
  - Logs a warning `MountSpawn : no animal <species> in the library` and makes nothing when the species is missing.
  - Without a GroundField but with a terrain, builds a TerrainField (with its own MarchingCubes) for the ground heights.
- **[Mountables](../systems/Mountables.md)**
  - Connects `on_destroy<Mountable>` in preinit (disconnected in finish).
  - Reads the species' skin geometry (`resources/animals/species/<id>.bin`) once per species, runs `analyseGait` on its walk clip.
  - Creates a collider entity per Mountable within `range` of a Rider (or ridden) and destroys it when none is.
  - Logs once per species: `Mountables : <id>, saddle <h> m up on <joint>, walks <v> m/s, runs <v> m/s` (info), or a warning when the geometry cannot be read.
- **[Mounting](../systems/Mounting.md)**
  - `CollideShape` of the player's capsule, at its place and 0.6 m lower, with max separation `reach`, on a press of jump when not riding.
  - Sets the collision group of the ridden animal's collider; clears it 0.6 s after getting off.
  - On a jump off: `SetLinearVelocity` of the player (the saddle's velocity plus `hop` m/s to the animal's left and 1 m/s up).
- **[RiderSeat](../systems/RiderSeat.md)**
  - At each physics step: `AddForce` on the rider's body ((pull - gravity) x mass) and `ActivateBody`.
- **[animals](../systems/pass-animals.md)**
  - Loads species geometry and textures on taskflow workers; uploads buffers and textures.
  - Writes the skinning matrices of the frame into a mapped storage buffer per frame in flight.
  - With ray tracing records animal_skin.rt.comp.glsl dispatches into the frame's compute command buffer.
  - Logs species loaded and failures, and a warning past 65536 joints in view.
